title: Jobs
purpose: Coordinates the Jobs family and reports scheduled house job activity.
description: PARENT of the Jobs family. Lists and triggers the child job add-ons (Jobs - Backup, Jobs - Met Office), hosts plugins (app/plugins, option plugins) and still runs both jobs itself until you turn that off. All local details are options. DRY-RUN by default (logs what it would set); a job goes live per job (live_jobs) after any older loop is switched off. Maps the media and share folders (read-write) for the photo, receipt and inbox plugins; the brain_stats plugin only reads the brain folder in share.
